body:
New idunapro whoami <base-url> <token> subcommand -- real, now-unblocked next step, closed the same session as the /api/v1/identities/me local-auth fix (every login-minted local-auth token would have gotten a bare 404 from whoami before that fix landed). Pure fetch-and-print against the real /me endpoint, same 'no ambiguous response to interpret' reasoning kanban list already established for staying entirely Go-native. 4 new tests. go build/vet/test clean, gofmt clean. Live-verified with the actual compiled binary against a real, freshly-booted instance: real register -> real idunapro login -> real idunapro whoami, correct identity printed. Commit b9e8582.

⚓ ☃
title: 9988 (cruise): whoami CLI subcommand shipped
